annotations.title: List the pages of a site from its sitemap

description: The pages of a site, with dates. Send a domain (example.com) or a sitemap address; get back up to 200 URLs with their lastmod date (UTC; null when the sitemap gave none or an unreadable one) and a signed observation (address read, fingerprint of the URLs returned, time). One level of sitemap index is followed (up to 5 child sitemaps on the same host). Free. Nothing is stored. Public http(s) only (ports 80 and 443), 1.5 MB per file. The addresses are whatever the sitemap says, and none is fetched. Limits: Fetches with the user agent 'Countersign/1.0 (checker; LLPRO)'. At most 6 GETs per call (the sitemap and up to 5 children; for a bare domain, robots.txt may be read first). Compressed (.gz) sitemaps are not read. Docs: https://llpro.ai/sitemap-reader

site.description: A domain such as example.com, or the public http(s) address of a sitemap.
